angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 7,043,501 km at 135.38 pc = 0.7 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.3867 +/- 0.0153 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 135.38 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 10.124 (9.921 to 10.328) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 7,043,501 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.801 (2.349 to 2.841) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4939 +/- 6.5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1315900158983769472: teff_gspphot 4938.5146 K (16th-84th percentiles 4931.8877-4944.814), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1315900158983769472: teff_gspphot 4938.5146 K (16th-84th percentiles 4931.8877-4944.814), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kamuy.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 2.875, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 145457 (pscomppars): spectral type K0, from Cannon & Pickering 1918 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1918AnHar..91....1C/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 145457: main object type RG*, Red Giant Branch star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 145457 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.14 dex, from Sato et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010PASJ...62.1063S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 145457 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.65514, from Sato et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010PASJ...62.1063S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 145457 (pscomppars): age 2.605 Gyr, from Sousa et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...576A..94S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
